known_negative_and_identifiability_limit: Nonzero predictive gain does not distinguish a causal peer effect (0.4) from no peer effect (0).
Group variance contrast relies on specified independence or shared-latent-U assumptions and cannot be generalized under arbitrary dependence.
Conditioning on artificially independent own prior action X leaves observational equivalence intact, not a proof controlling for real human subject-level traits.
R073–R077 are four observed source studies, not new human evidence from R078; their risk sets, fit regimes and target meanings differ.
No institutional, multi-generational or historical evolution model was validated.
